[IDSP.6.4] **NULL callback policy: ESSENTIAL.** NULL-cb returns
`DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` (not `DS_ERR_ACTION_FAILED`
— that code is reserved for "cb ran but reported
failure"). A calling rule that registered no call
callback gets a pump-time error.

A replay is the exception. It hands no re-derived call to the call callback
([LFST.9.2], [NDET.8.2]), so a replaying engine with none raises no error for
it.
